order: Split recon into two tiers by the kind of question asked. Keep the existing scout for every where-and-what mission — locate, map, enumerate, history — cheap, parallel and high-recall. Add a detective role for the why-and-how cases, root-cause analysis, cross-subsystem tracing, invariant discovery, cases where fact-gathering cannot be separated from reasoning, where a confidently wrong report would misdirect the plan. The detective carries the scout's read-only law unchanged, since recon is the one unreviewed output in the harness and the intelligence steering decisions gets the capable tier. Write the detective charter with hypothesis-first rules, path-and-line evidence chains and graded CONFIRMED, LIKELY, UNCERTAIN verdicts, then narrow the scout's description from all codebase searching and add a rule handing causal cores off as detective cases. Add the company-table row, two-tier routing with pipelining plus an escalation rule making a scout UNKNOWN that survives one re-probe a detective case, then update the guard's denial hint, the stamped agent set, docs plus version.
claims: The new role is added under the same read-only law, the scout hands causal cores off, and the routing, escalation, guard hint, stamped agent set, documentation and version bump are all in place. A --check pass clears the installer and both of its supporting scripts, 3 of 3. An install-then-uninstall round-trip into a scratch directory then stamps the six agent charters and returns the project to a standard setup.
